list.query: SELECT toString(session_key) AS __value, concat(toString(year), ' ', circuit_name) AS __text FROM default.mart_driver_pace WHERE session_type = 'Race' GROUP BY session_key, year, circuit_name ORDER BY session_key DESC

panels.title: Race Positions
panels.description: Position of every driver at the end of every lap, derived from cumulative race time. P1 is at the top, P22 at the bottom. Crossings are overtakes (on track or via pit stops). Click legend entries to isolate or compare drivers.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cum AS (
  SELECT driver_number, name_acronym, lap_number,
         sum(lap_duration) OVER (PARTITION BY driver_number ORDER BY lap_number) AS race_time
  FROM default.fct_laps
  WHERE session_key = ${session_key} AND lap_duration IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT lap_number, name_acronym,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY lap_number ORDER BY race_time) AS pos
  FROM cum
)
SELECT toUInt32(lap_number) AS Lap,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'VER'))) AS VER,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'NOR'))) AS NOR,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'PIA'))) AS PIA,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'LEC'))) AS LEC,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'RUS'))) AS RUS,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'HAM'))) AS HAM,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'ANT'))) AS ANT,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'SAI'))) AS SAI,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'ALB'))) AS ALB,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'GAS'))) AS GAS,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'ALO'))) AS ALO,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'STR'))) AS STR,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'HUL'))) AS HUL,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'BEA'))) AS BEA,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'BOR'))) AS BOR,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'LAW'))) AS LAW,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'OCO'))) AS OCO,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'COL'))) AS COL,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'HAD'))) AS HAD,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'LIN'))) AS LIN,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'PER'))) AS PER,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(maxIf(23 - pos, name_acronym = 'BOT'))) AS BOT
FROM ranked
GROUP BY lap_number
ORDER BY lap_number

panels.title: Tyre Strategies
panels.description: Total laps each driver completed on each compound. Horizontal stacked bars: length = number of laps; colour = compound (red SOFT, yellow MEDIUM, white HARD, green INTER, blue WET).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name_acronym AS Driver,
       countIf(compound = 'SOFT')         AS SOFT,
       countIf(compound = 'MEDIUM')       AS MEDIUM,
       countIf(compound = 'HARD')         AS HARD,
       countIf(compound = 'INTERMEDIATE') AS INTER,
       countIf(compound = 'WET')          AS WET
FROM default.fct_laps
WHERE session_key = ${session_key} AND lap_duration IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY name_acronym
ORDER BY count() DESC

panels.title: Pace: Drivers
panels.description: Per-driver clean-lap pace. Best lap (fastest single tour), median (true race pace, immune to outliers) and 75th percentile (consistency proxy). Sorted ascending by median: leftmost was the fastest on average.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name_acronym AS Driver,
       round(min(lap_duration), 3)            AS Best,
       round(median(lap_duration), 3)         AS Median,
       round(quantile(0.75)(lap_duration), 3) AS P75
FROM default.fct_laps
WHERE session_key = ${session_key}
  AND is_pit_out_lap = 0
  AND lap_duration IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY name_acronym
ORDER BY Median ASC

panels.title: Pace: Teams
panels.description: Per-team clean-lap pace summary aggregated across both team drivers. Best, median and 75th percentile. Sorted ascending by median to surface the team that was outright quickest on race pace.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT team_name AS Team,
       round(min(lap_duration), 3)            AS Best,
       round(median(lap_duration), 3)         AS Median,
       round(quantile(0.75)(lap_duration), 3) AS P75
FROM default.fct_laps
WHERE session_key = ${session_key}
  AND is_pit_out_lap = 0
  AND lap_duration IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY team_name
ORDER BY Median ASC

panels.title: Gap Race  (vs Race Leader)
panels.description: Cumulative time gap of every driver to the race leader at every lap. Negative = ahead at that point. Sharp upward jumps are pit stops; gentle climbs reveal pace deficits. Click legend entries to isolate or compare 2 or more drivers.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cum AS (
  SELECT driver_number, name_acronym, lap_number,
         sum(lap_duration) OVER (PARTITION BY driver_number ORDER BY lap_number) AS race_time
  FROM default.fct_laps
  WHERE session_key = ${session_key} AND lap_duration IS NOT NULL
),
final_times AS (
  SELECT name_acronym,
         max(lap_number) AS final_lap,
         argMax(race_time, lap_number) AS final_time
  FROM cum GROUP BY name_acronym
),
leader AS (
  SELECT name_acronym AS leader_name FROM final_times
  ORDER BY final_lap DESC, final_time ASC LIMIT 1
),
leader_per_lap AS (
  SELECT lap_number, race_time AS leader_time
  FROM cum WHERE name_acronym = (SELECT leader_name FROM leader)
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT cum.lap_number AS lap,
         cum.name_acronym AS drv,
         round(cum.race_time - lp.leader_time, 2) AS gap
  FROM cum
  LEFT JOIN leader_per_lap lp ON cum.lap_number = lp.lap_number
)
SELECT toUInt32(lap) AS Lap,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'VER'), 2) AS VER,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'NOR'), 2) AS NOR,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'PIA'), 2) AS PIA,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'LEC'), 2) AS LEC,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'RUS'), 2) AS RUS,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'HAM'), 2) AS HAM,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'ANT'), 2) AS ANT,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'SAI'), 2) AS SAI,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'ALB'), 2) AS ALB,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'GAS'), 2) AS GAS,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'ALO'), 2) AS ALO,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'STR'), 2) AS STR,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'HUL'), 2) AS HUL,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'BEA'), 2) AS BEA,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'BOR'), 2) AS BOR,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'LAW'), 2) AS LAW,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'OCO'), 2) AS OCO,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'COL'), 2) AS COL,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'HAD'), 2) AS HAD,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'LIN'), 2) AS LIN,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'PER'), 2) AS PER,
       round(maxIf(gap, drv = 'BOT'), 2) AS BOT
FROM gaps
GROUP BY lap
ORDER BY lap

panels.title: Speed Trap
panels.description: Highest end-of-straight speed (km/h) reached by every driver during the race only (qualifying / sprint sessions excluded). Sorted descending so the fastest car on the straight is on the left.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name_acronym AS Driver,
       max(st_speed) AS TopSpeed
FROM default.fct_laps
WHERE session_key = ${session_key}
  AND session_type = 'Race'
  AND st_speed > 0
GROUP BY name_acronym
ORDER BY TopSpeed DESC

panels.title: Sector Bests — per Driver
panels.description: Best individual sector times of the race per driver, plus their fastest lap and median pace. Highlights where each car excels: high-speed S1 vs technical S2 vs traction-dependent S3.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name_acronym                AS Driver,
       team_name                   AS Team,
       round(best_sector_1, 3)     AS S1,
       round(best_sector_2, 3)     AS S2,
       round(best_sector_3, 3)     AS S3,
       round(fastest_lap, 3)       AS BestLap,
       round(median_lap, 3)        AS MedianPace,
       lap_count                   AS Laps
FROM default.mart_driver_pace
WHERE session_key = ${session_key}
ORDER BY BestLap ASC
